author: PC Gamer
text:
Garry Newman responds to s&box criticism in lengthy YouTube comment: 'I don't like giving up on things, I am stubborn'
He certainly seems to be aware of the problems.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Kingdom Come: Deliverance studio co-founder says a lot of RPGs are 'still games for teenagers,' and that he's 'tired of all the RPGs where you are this chosen one'
"Everybody's going to think that I am hating on Expedition 33 right now, but that's definitely not the case."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Brigador devs: 'The '90s PC classics often taught really special things, but not because the story said, Wow, violence is bad!'
Brigador Killers wants to make you think, not tell you how to feel.

author: PC Gamer
text:
What does your dream videogame concert look like?
You are the conductor.

author: PC Gamer
text:
RuneScape is getting a new character type that promises a fresh start, but existing players are wary of splitting the community up
RuneScape Reignited is a new way to play RS3… kind of.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Tonda Ros, creator of Blue Prince, has played UFO 50 for almost 700 hours: 'I think it's easily my favourite game of the last 20 years'
The designer of 2025's celebrated puzzler guides us through the games on his PC.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Silent Hill: Townfall is the first horror game to make me feel bad for using a shotgun
I was perhaps too trigger-happy.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Yet another free fan level pack for Quake has arrived, and this one's all about a feature rarely seen in id Software's classic shooter
Quake Rooftops Jam takes a bird's eye view to level design.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Grand Theft Auto 6 features 'detailed decapitation' and 'frequent and prominent' drug use, according to hastily deleted PEGI rating
Jason and Lucia can also snort cocaine "directly from their hand at any time."

author: PC Gamer
text:
An OpenAI model was caught trying to cheat at StarCraft, and of course it did it by stealing a human's work
GPT-6 Astra tried to get a leg-up in Blizzard's RTS by pilfering a human-created bot.

author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA 6 won't be letting up on the satire: 'If you are going to put all this effort into creating a version of today's world, it has to be more over the top, more insane, more in your face'
Lucia and Jason's appearance in a fashion magazine gives us a couple more titbits of GTA info.

author: PC Gamer
text:
One of the most popular Total War: Warhammer 3 mods was 'deliberately corrupted' by its creator to sabotage AI-made copies
SFO Grimhammer 3 has since been restored to its original version, but the point's been made.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Crimson Desert DLC delayed by 2 weeks, please join me in wishing the devs a fond 'take your time, please drink some water'
Even a man forged from steel falters sometimes.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valorant player claims to have inherited hardware ban through secondhand CPU, Riot anticheat boss disputes parts of story
Unlikely, but not impossible?

author: PC Gamer
text:
RuneScape 4 announced at RuneFest, full MMO sequel started as expansion to survival game Dragonwilds
An unstoppable juggernaut.
